stories.headline: Ja'Marr Chase Sat Out Wednesday With a Bum Knee, and the Whole Saloon Just Went Quiet
stories.read: Pardner, when the fella folks are spendin' the first pick of the land grab on don't practice, you sit up straight. Chase left Tuesday's session early with a knee, told the room Tuesday he could suit up and play right now, then didn't take a single rep Wednesday. That's a team bein' careful with sixteen days till the opener, not a wagon with a busted axle, so don't you dare let a panicky leaguemate buy him off you at a discount. But if you're drafting today and Chase somehow slides a spot or two past where the herd's been grabbin' him, that's the cheapest gold on the whole Trail. Take him and tip your hat.

stories.headline: Cleveland Hands the Reins to Deshaun Watson, and Shedeur Sanders Rides the Pine
stories.read: Todd Monken made his call and it wasn't the popular one: Watson starts Week 1 in Jacksonville, and the coach says plain that this ain't a week-to-week thing. Now here's the read, and it ain't kind. That Cleveland passing game just got harder to trust across the board, so Jerry Jeudy and every pass-catcher in that camp slides down a rung on your board. The real money's in the backfield, because a shaky thrower means more handoffs, and Quinshon Judkins' share of the haul just got fatter than a fall bear. Go stake the Browns' runnin' game while the outfit's still arguin' about the quarterback.

stories.headline: Najee Harris Signs in New York, and the Giants Backfield Just Got Mighty Crowded
stories.read: The Giants brought Najee in for a look Monday and had ink on a one-year minimum deal a day later, which tells you they didn't much like what they saw in that room. Cam Skattebo's still atop the pecking order on paper, but he's comin' back off a busted leg that'd make a mule wince, and now he's got Najee, Tyrone Tracy and Devin Singletary all reachin' for the same reins. Nobody signs a former Pro Bowl back for the fourth chair. Knock Skattebo down a round from where the saloon's payin', and if Najee's still sittin' there in the last few rounds of your draft, stake him: a minimum-salary fella one tweak away from goal-line work is exactly the vein this Gazette was built to find.
